name: windows-server-search
description: Search, read, copy and save files on Windows file servers through their Windows Search index. Automatically uses the network drives already mapped on this PC (e.g. Z: -> \\fileserver\share); no setup needed. Windows only.

servers.title: Additional servers / shares
servers.description: Optional. UNC paths to search in addition to mapped drives, separated by ';' (e.g. \\fs01\projects;\\fs02). A bare server name searches all of its shares.

auto_discover.title: Use mapped network drives
auto_discover.description: Automatically search all Windows servers behind the network drives mapped on this PC.

exclude.title: Exclude servers / shares
exclude.description: Optional. Server names or UNC share paths to ignore, separated by ';'.

deny_paths.title: Blocked paths
deny_paths.description: Optional. Wildcard patterns Claude may never search, list, read or copy, separated by ';' (e.g. \\fs01\hr\**;**\Personal;**\*.kdbx). In Cowork, list them gitignore-style in %APPDATA%\windows-server-search-mcp\.claude-policy instead. IT can also block paths centrally via a .claude-policy file in each share or Group Policy.

max_results.title: Default maximum results
max_results.description: Default number of results returned per search (1-500).

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Optional. Local folder that copy_file uses when no destination is given (e.g. your Cowork workspace folder). Default: Downloads\Windows Server Search.

allow_write.title: Allow writing to servers
allow_write.description: Let Claude save files to the shares with the save_file tool (never to blocked paths, never overwriting unless allowed below). On by default. In Cowork, disable it in %APPDATA%\windows-server-search-mcp\config.json ("write": {"enabled": false}); IT can disable it via Group Policy (DisableWrite=1).

allow_overwrite.title: Allow overwriting files
allow_overwrite.description: Let save_file replace existing files when asked (overwrite: true); the previous version is always kept as <name>.claude-backup-<timestamp>. On by default; disable with "write": {"allowOverwrite": false} in the config file.
